name: Research
description: Research communication system balancing evidence, methodology, diagrams, and readable scientific captions.
localized_description: 面向科研汇报和论文答辩的证据型版式，强调方法、结果、图注和可复核的信息层级。

layouts.description: Scientific cover with hypothesis statement and a protected figure area.
Research question split into context, gap, and contribution columns.
Methodology process flow with numbered stages and compact explanatory notes.
Primary chart with a visible takeaway headline and an anchored figure caption.
Image grid for microscopy, experiment samples, or visual result comparisons.
Control versus treatment comparison with aligned labels and evidence notes.
Large figure with a right-side callout rail for variables, limits, and interpretation.
Conclusion, limitations, and next experiment arranged as three decision blocks.
